scope: Offline generated GPU-upload/VP/NVENC quality candidates; no DDA, USB or optical latency measurement
metric_note: PSNR is derived from arithmetic mean pixel MSE over equal-sized frames, not mean frame PSNR. Coded bitrate is normalized to nominal 100 fps, not wall time.
caveats: One generated source and seed, one run per candidate; no arbitrary-input quality guarantee.
All candidates share a 20 Mbps target, but actual useful encoded bitrates differ; this is not an equal-actual-bitrate comparison.
Canonical NV12 source is converted to RGB and back on GPU; absolute error includes the shared conversion, and does not isolate NVENC alone.
The final overwrite segment is adversarial every-frame new content, not a proxy for every FPV simulator scene.
Block MSE >100 is a diagnostic threshold, not a validated perceptual threshold.
Initial slice QP does not expose macroblock quantizers, especially with AQ.
A passed identity/chain test does not prove the absence of DDA ownership or receiver display problems.
recommendation: Prefer High/CABAC with qres and symmetric -4 chroma offsets. Relative to zero-offset High there is a small luma-quality cost, while colour-edge regression passes and motion remains materially better than Baseline. Preserve all earlier candidates and the zero-offset colour-gate failure.

selected_policy.basis: Motion/colour candidate acceptance; not optical acceptance or a claim that every metric improves.

provenance_note: Generator hashes identify the exact tools used for these runs. Portable source copies may change ROOT or cleanup code; see reproduction notes rather than assuming a byte-identical tool.

cpu_nv12_vs_gpu_upload.scope: Both paths use NVIDIA NVENC High/qres at the same target; CPU NV12 means raw input format, not software encoding.
cpu_nv12_vs_gpu_upload.identity_scope: Every published per-frame metric, identity, AU size and initial QP agrees. Full encoded or decoded byte hashes were not retained for this cross-path comparison.

independent_gpu_raw_conversion.interpretation: The 240 generated raw NV12 pictures match all three truth planes. This is a separate pass over generated content, not the exact encoded input surfaces or real DDA capture.

selection_status: High/qres plus symmetric -4 chroma offsets passes motion integrity and the unchanged colour gate; final release timing/installation checks are recorded separately.
